children: Solv Protocol has scheduled an unlock of 159.32 million SOLV for August 2027. The tokens are allocated to investors, the team, and ecosystem wallets. The full release is equal to 2.70% of SOLV's circulating supply.
Once the lock expires, investors and team members can offer SOLV from their allocations for sale. This adds previously locked insider holdings to the supply available for trading.

title: Solv Protocol: Unlocks 2.7% of circulating SOLV supply - Aug 2027
